description: POST /v1/messages/count_tokens to a Claude upstream with fields only generating uses (max_tokens, temperature, stream), as a client counting a create request sends them.

headers.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: Authorization, Content-Type, X-Api-Key, X-Goog-Api-Key, Anthropic-Version, Anthropic-Beta
headers.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, OPTIONS
headers.Access-Control-Expose-Headers: X-CPA-TRACE-ID, X-CPA-VERSION, X-CPA-COMMIT, X-CPA-BUILD-DATE, X-CPA-SUPPORT-PLUGIN, X-CPA-HOME-VERSION, X-CPA-HOME-BUILD-DATE, X-SERVER-VERSION, X-SERVER-BUILD-DATE, Location, Retry-After, ETag, X-Request-Id, OpenAI-Request-Id

exceptions.reason: The new core counts tokens with the upstream's own count endpoint (Anthropic's /v1/messages/count_tokens), so the count and any error are the upstream's; today's core answers itself with a local tokenizer estimate when the account's base URL is not Anthropic's own, and makes no upstream request.

The new core counts tokens with the upstream's own count endpoint (Anthropic's /v1/messages/count_tokens), so the count and any error are the upstream's; today's core answers itself with a local tokenizer estimate when the account's base URL is not Anthropic's own, and makes no upstream request. The body goes without the fields only generating uses (max_tokens, temperature, stream), which count_tokens refuses.
